_readme: One-off image posts (not Reels). Dispatch reels.yml with image_slug=<slug>. feed = 4:5 for the IG + FB feed, story = 9:16 for IG + FB Stories. Captions end with an open question (Alan's rule). picture: 'real' = a real photo from a live listing or the real app; 'stock' = AI, Canva or stock. post_image.py posts only 'real' (Alan 11-26, real items only). Tip posts (tip-*) are made by brand/posts/make_tips.py from brand/posts/tips.json: run it again the day a tip posts, so the 'On YardSwaps now' chip is checked against the live listing.
